headline: Wells Fargo Maintains Equal-Weight on HCA Healthcare, Raises Price Target to $381
summary: Wells Fargo  analyst Stephen Baxter   maintains HCA Healthcare (NYSE:HCA) with a Equal-Weight and raises the price target from $369 to $381.
